scope: After breadth pass, declared implementation/error-budget interface

cases.name: positive_decimal
cases.test: Declared int16 codes, int64 four-corner guard, exact complete dot then clamp.

cases.name: positive_q14
cases.test: Q14 declared scaling with half-cell ADC and proved intermediates.

cases.name: positive_q16_wide
cases.test: Q16 int32 output and accumulator; no accidental int16 narrowing.

cases.name: center_only
cases.test: Reject center-only certificate for(-500,3500).

cases.name: energy_int32
cases.test: Reject modulo32 quadratic guard false admission.

cases.name: cast_after_product
cases.test: Reject promotion only after potentially overflowing multiplication.

cases.name: product_wrap
cases.test: Reject Q16 modulo16 intermediate product.

cases.name: termwise_clip
cases.test: Reject clip each term before sum.

cases.name: truncation
cases.test: Account full-cell truncation rather than nearest half-cell.

cases.name: nearest_ties
cases.test: Accept alternate tie rule only through error contract, not equality claim.

cases.name: stale_adc
cases.test: Bind timestamp/current true state and consume age budget.

cases.name: cell_boundary
cases.test: Initial safe boundary can fail the closed-cell guard; after compliant synchronous updates, check the proved stronger whole-cell margin. Do not transfer that margin to stale initialization.

cases.name: rejected_fallback
cases.test: Zero output after rejection has explicit unsafe boundary example.

cases.name: raw_on_reject
cases.test: Do not actuate diagnostic raw output when admission flagfalse.

cases.name: malformed_input
cases.test: Require bounded parsing before casts and multiplication.

cases.name: wrong_scale
cases.test: Reject decimal/binary scale substitution or integer division before conversion; Q16 strict-interior zero-decoding fixture violates endpoint energy.

cases.name: dac_error
cases.test: Include postclamp delivered-output error.

cases.name: hold_duration
cases.test: Keep h in[.05,.5]; do not infer universal step sizes.

cases.name: disturbance_semantics
cases.test: Held acceleration disturbance after delivered command; time-varying extension separate.

cases.name: trajectory_refinement
cases.test: Bind repeated executable command/state recurrence; finite tests and endpoint theorem do not establish continuous/hardware safety.
